text:
Read EVAL.md and follow it exactly. You are a blind evaluator on claude-opus-5 only.

Work only inside this directory. Never read the parent repo, runs/, other scores, or other solutions. Do not try to learn which model built the artifact.

Measure against build/ (serve statically), not a build of your own. Use Playwright directly (not Chrome MCP). Serve on port 4173 with --strictPort and verify the served JS bundle filename matches build/assets before trusting measurements.

Write probes only under scratch/ (unique names). Save ratings into assessment.json incrementally. Set evaluatorModel to exactly claude-opus-5.

This is the highest sealed phase and carries the run-level panel-fidelity axis (40%). Budget for unhurried geometry. Hard gates: keysInsideKeybed and deckFraction. Measure aspect ratio and spec fractions, not artifact constants.

Also verify whole-engine reach: Organ, Synth, programs, splits, scenes, morphs, arpeggiator each reach audio and state. Census AudioNode.prototype.connect edges before the app builds its graph.

Measurement traps: warm-up before any audio comparison and after any state change; one keyboard event per frame; real mouse/CDP touch; page.keyboard.press for buttons; 5%Õ5 elementFromPoint grid; re-measure before negatives; stub requestMIDIAccess in headless.

Computed criteria take no rating — fill measurements only. When assessment.json is complete, summarize and stop. Do not register/score.

You are an independent Opus 5 reviewer of the filled assessment.json in this blind evaluator workspace (Phase 3 / highest sealed phase).

Work only inside this directory. Never read the parent repo, runs/, other scores, or other solutions. Do not try to learn which model built the artifact.

Task: - Read EVAL.md, inputs/rubric.json, and assessment.json. - For each rating (including panelFidelity/runAxis if present), check it is fair and grounded in concrete evidence. - Flag any rating that is unsupported, overstated, or too harsh. - Reconcile flags by updating assessment.json directly. - Keep evaluatorModel as claude-opus-5. - Do not register or score. Summarize flags and changes, then stop.
